phases.title: 0. Owner actions & decisions
phases.why: Answers and console clicks only the owner can do. Each decision unblocks a group of work further down; until it is answered those rows show ⛔.

items.note: Owner checklist: merge/release, keystore backup, secrets, real-printer smoke
Staff visibility; unblocks #76, #78, #154 and #18 read rules
Decide before rules hardening (#18/#19) and before #169/#170
Today = cash session or midnight; unblocks #47
Retail sales and stock; needed by oracle tests #45
Cash deposit meaning; unblocks cash tolerance in #37
Desktop/Android distribution; after the #139 spike if needed
Decide in-app inbox vs push first; unblocks #56
Firebase ownership; do the move together with #35
Non-blocking questionnaire; blanks use the listed defaults

phases.title: 1. Stop data loss (backups, rules, destructive ops)
phases.why: Nothing else matters if data can be wiped or overwritten. Rules tests in CI first, so every rules change after it is checked.

Run rules tests + check:release in CI before touching rules

Write rules; coordinate path shape with #149; read side after #84
Owner disables account (#168 step 4); remove users doc
Staff edit window in UI + rules
Signed APK release so fixes reach phones

phases.title: 2. Money correctness
phases.why: Wrong totals and silent drift erode trust in every report. Small, high-impact fixes in billing/settings.

items.note: Labour rate in Firestore; do with #21, #151
Wholesale split at save (same M1 check)
Totals from items, not screen text
Phones miss payments on old bills settled in the window: rules (paidAt) first, then the app
Stock-up weekly kg: say so when under 8 weeks are loaded

phases.why: Tests that guard money paths go in before refactors; then one shared period/profit module, void instead of delete, and save-time checks.

items.note: Every displayed number gets a spec + oracle test

Server time; pairs with #37 backdate checks
